group_company.meaning: Guests from the same company must sit together, each company forming one block.

group_category.meaning: Guests of the same category must sit together, each category forming one block.

spread.meaning: Guests of the same category must be spread out: hand the categories out in turn, one guest of each category, then the next round, instead of letting a category sit together.

order_rank.meaning: Seat guests in order of their RSVP rank number, lowest number first.

order_rankdesc.meaning: Seat guests in order of their RSVP rank number, highest number first.

order_category.meaning: Seat categories in a priority sequence given by a phrase {LIST} (categories not in the list come afterwards).
slots: {LIST}: the categories in priority sequence written as a natural phrase, e.g. 'government officials, then AI labs, then investors' (1 to 4 categories)

order_company.meaning: Seat companies in a priority sequence given by a phrase {LIST} (other companies come afterwards).
slots: {LIST}: the companies in priority sequence as a natural phrase, e.g. 'Nvidia, then Palantir' (1 to 4 companies)

sections.meaning: The table is divided into sections of {S} seats; the answer is which section each guest is in.
slots: {S}: the section size, written as a digit like 6 or a number word like six

captains.meaning: The table is divided into sections of {S} seats; the answer is only the captain of each section (the guest with the lowest RSVP rank number).
slots: {S}: the section size, written as a digit or a number word
